{"version": 1, "content": "

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the list in the note above.

  • Load Diffusion Model (Qwen Image 2.1) - The image model itself, 7B, from Alibaba's Qwen team.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 8B) - Reads your prompt and looks at your pictures.
  • Load VAE - Turns pictures into the model's own format and back. It works with four channels, red, green, blue and transparency, which is how this model can hand back a transparent picture.

 The numbers you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you have to touch.

  • 1. Load Image - The person. Here a woman in a head-and-shoulders photo. In the prompt it is <image1>.
  • 2. Load Image - An animal. Here a cat. In the prompt it is <image2>.
  • 3. Load Image - A second animal. Here a dog. In the prompt it is <image3>.
  • 4. Load Image - The place. Here a sunny terrace with nobody on it. In the prompt it is <image4>.
  • 5. Pick Orientation and Size - The size and shape of the new picture, any shape you like: it does not follow the pictures. The starred sizes are Qwen's native 2K ones and much slower.
  • 6. Add a prompt - What to make, and what to keep. Name the pictures by their tags.
  • 7. Seed Random/Fixed? - Fixed repeats the same result, Random rolls a new one each Run.

 The speed nodes

Teal, above the graph.

  • Qwen Image 2.1 Cache - Where the model keeps what it has already worked out about your pictures and the prompt, so it does not redo that on every step. Leave it on auto / default. The note in workflow 1 (Outfit Change) says when to change it.
  • Model Attention Backend - Set to comfy kitchen attention, a faster way to do the model's attention maths. It changes the speed, not the picture. On a graphics card that cannot use it, ComfyUI falls back to normal attention by itself.

 The render

Green. These run by themselves.

  • Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 - Reads your prompt and your pictures, and resizes the pictures to about 1024 x 1024 first. Its negative prompt box does nothing at CFG 1, the setting this model is made for, so leave it empty.
  • Empty Latent Image - The blank canvas, at the size from step 5. The encoder's own canvas would copy picture 1's shape.
  • KSampler - The render: 25 steps, euler, simple, CFG 1, the settings from ComfyUI's own template.
  • VAE Decode - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Preview Image Pixaroma - Shows the result and saves it to your output folder as a PNG.

There is no Compare node here: the result is a new picture made from all of yours, so there is no single before picture to hold it against. The dark Run Timer above it shows how long the last Run took.

widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "content": "

SETTINGS AND RUN TIME

 What this workflow makes

One new photo from all four pictures: the woman from picture 1 in the armchair on the terrace from picture 4, with the cat from picture 2 on her lap and the dog from picture 3 beside her.

Every number below was measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow and its own settings, each run on a fresh seed with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the cost goes up with the pixels.

 How long a Run takes

What changed1024 x 1024
New pictures or prompt19 s
New seed only14 s

For bigger sizes, see the table in workflow 1 (Outfit Change): native 2K took about five times as long as 1 MP there, and it grows the same way here.

The graphics card peaked at about 19 GB during these runs.

 Writing the prompt

  • Name each picture by its tag, <image1> to <image4>, and give each one a job and a place: who, what is on her lap, what sits beside the chair, where.
  • People and animals on a plain background are the easiest for the model to take from.
  • Say how close the shot is. In an earlier test without a medium shot from the knees up, the model showed the person full body, small in the frame, on 8 of 8 seeds.
  • Pick the shape of the new picture in step 5. It does not have to match any of the pictures.

Tested on 8 seeds: every one kept her face and yellow t-shirt, put the cat on her lap and the dog beside the chair, on the terrace.

 The other edit workflows

Kitchen attention, the memory node, the first Run of the session and the full size table are explained in workflow 1 (Outfit Change). They work the same way here.

# MiniMax H3 — Singularity Dual-Sampling Workflow

## Made by The AI Brief
https://www.youtube.com/@TheAIBriefYT20

### Workflow
- Multi-reference image, video, and audio inputs
- MiniMax H3 reference-to-video generation
- Configurable reAttention Backendution and duration
- Dual-sampling / sigma workflow
- Optional latent upscaling
- Video + audio decode and export

### Notes
Keep the workflow organized from left to right:
**Inputs → Prompt & Controls → MiniMax H3 → Sampling → Upscale → Decode → Output**

All workflow notes and labels are in English.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1> with spiky blonde hair featuring red tips/highlights, long dangling red tassel earrings, wearing a sleeveless royal blue cloak with gold trimming, gold arm cuffs, bracers, and a blue gem ring, posing with crossed arms.
<Subject 2> is the young woman with long pink-red hair, light-cream short-sleeved collared knit shirt, holding a glass cup in <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is the young woman with a high dark bun, off-the-shoulder white cropped sweater, grey slit skirt, and fishnet stockings in <Picture 3>.
<Subject 4> is the dark-haired young woman with cat ears, blue-highlighted hair, tied white printed t-shirt, and black leather skirt in <Picture 4>.
<Subject 5> is the elegant woman with mauve-pink hair, rimless glasses, grey suit outfit, and white blouse holding a blue folder in <Picture 5>.
<Subject 6> is the traditional East Asian study environment in <Picture 6>, featuring dark wooden beams, bamboo screens, a large calligraphy desk with scrolls, a bonsai tree, and an outdoor bamboo garden view through open lattice windows.
<Audio 1> is the vocal timbre and speech style reference for all speakers (<Subject 1> through <Subject 5> / S1 through S5).

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] In a first-person perspective (POV), the 5 characters (<Subject 1> through <Subject 5>) appear sequentially inside <Subject 6>, stepping forward toward the viewer one by one to greet the audience directly using the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1> before stepping aside for the next character.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - blonde and red-highlighted hair, red tassel earrings, sleeveless royal blue outfit with gold details, gold bracers, and fierce amber eyes are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - pink-red hair, delicate facial features, and light-cream top are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - bun hairstyle, off-the-shoulder white sweater, and stylish aesthetic are retained.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - cat ears, blue hair highlights, white tied t-shirt, and leather skirt are retained.
<Subject 5> (appears in [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - mauve hair, glasses, grey professional suit, and refined demeanor are retained.
<Subject 6> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the traditional bamboo courtyard study environment, wooden furniture, and lighting are maintained throughout.
<Audio 1>: reference - its voice timbre, pitch characteristics, and speech cadence guide the spoken delivery of all five characters without copying the original signal directly.

detailed_description:
The video is shot from a first-person perspective (POV) with a cinematic, continuous storytelling style set inside <Subject 6>, the illuminated traditional East Asian study with soft daylight filtering through the bamboo trees outside.

[Shot 1] The camera is fixed at eye level facing the center of <Subject 6> near the wooden tea table. <Subject 1> (S1), the red-gold-haired young man with long red tassel earrings and royal blue draped outfit, steps forward from beside the bamboo screen toward the viewer, lowering his crossed arms as he approaches. He stops close to the lens, tilts his head slightly, looks directly at the camera with sharp amber eyes, and speaks using the clear voice timbre and cadence referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ，。</d> He smiles slightly, gestures with a flick of his golden bracer-adorned wrist, and steps gracefully to the left side of the frame.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, <Subject 2> (S2), the red-haired woman in the cream knit shirt, walks forward from behind the calligraphy desk into the center foreground. Holding a porcelain teacup with both hands, she looks brightly into the camera with a warm expression and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ，。</d> She nods warmly, takes a small sip, and steps to the right side of the frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, <Subject 3> (S3), the woman with the dark bun and white off-the-shoulder sweater, walks confidently forward toward the camera from the sunlit window background. She stops in front of the viewer, leans slightly forward with a playful smile, waving her hand close to the lens, and speaks in the same voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ！，！</d> She turns slightly and gestures toward the rest of the room before moving aside.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, <Subject 4> (S4), the young woman with cat ears and blue hair highlights in the white t-shirt, playfully hops forward into the close-up shot facing the viewer. She touches one of her cat ears, winks at the camera, and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ~ ，！</d> She makes a small paw-gesturing wave with her hand and steps back.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, <Subject 5> (S5), the woman with mauve-pink hair and glasses in the grey suit, adjusts her glasses with one hand while holding a blue notebook, stepping calmly into the center foreground. Looking elegantly into the camera with a gentle smile, she speaks in the refined voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ，，。</d> She gracefully bows her head slightly, extends her arm toward the tea table, and all five characters briefly align in the background looking toward the camera as the frame freezes at 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Gentle breeze through bamboo leaves, peaceful indoor room tone with soft tea-pouring sounds continuing faintly in the background.

non_diegetic_music:
A soft, elegant traditional guqin and bamboo flute melody playing softly in the background.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a 15-second casual vlog-style clip where <Subject 1> is recording herself on a mobile phone camera, talking directly to the audience about AI-generated content becoming indistinguishable from reality. The aesthetic is intentionally handheld, slightly imperfect, with natural lighting and authentic speech patterns including pauses and natural filler words.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - facial identity, red hair, freckles, green eyes, black cropped hoodie, gray leggings, white sneakers, silver watch, and athletic build remain consistent.
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - visual identity reference.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] From 00:00.000, the video opens with a handheld mobile phone camera perspective. The camera is slightly shaky with natural handheld movement, held at arm's length by <Subject 1> herself. She's standing in what appears to be her bedroom or a casual indoor space with soft natural window light from camera-left. The framing is a medium close-up, slightly off-center, with the camera angled slightly downward as if she's holding it herself.

<Subject 1> looks directly into the lens with an engaged, slightly excited expression. She's just started recording and is finding her words. She speaks in a natural, conversational tone:
<d>[English] Okay so... <inhale> I just saw this AI-generated video and I literally cannot tell if it's real anymore.</d>

Her hair moves naturally as she shifts her weight. The camera shakes slightly with her hand movements.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, she continues talking, gesturing with her free hand (her right hand) for emphasis. The camera angle shifts slightly as she adjusts her grip. She's animated but natural:
<d>[English] Like, the skin texture, the way the hair moves... <pause> it's actually insane.</d>

She briefly looks down at her phone screen as if checking something, then looks back up at the camera. Her expression is genuine amazement mixed with slight concern.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, she leans slightly closer to the camera, lowering her voice as if sharing something important:
<d>[English] I mean... <pause> what does "real" even mean anymore?</d>

She holds eye contact with the lens for a beat, her expression thoughtful. The video ends with her still looking at the camera, the handheld movement continuing naturally until 00:15.000.

The overall aesthetic should feel like a genuine social media vlog: natural lighting, slight camera shake, authentic speech rhythm with natural pauses, and a casual intimate framing. The image quality should feel like a modern smartphone camera - clear but not cinematic, with natural depth of field.

overall_soundscape:
Natural room tone with very subtle ambient background noise. The sound of her voice is clear but has the slight compression and frequency response of a phone microphone. Occasional subtle clothing rustle as she moves. No artificial audio processing.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A. This is meant to feel like a raw, unedited vlog recording with no added music.

She's standing in what appears to be her bedroom or a casual indoor space with soft natural window light from camera-left. The framing is a medium close-up, slightly off-center, with the camera angled slightly downward as if she's holding it herself.

<Subject 1> looks directly into the lens with an engaged, slightly excited expression. She's just started recording and is finding her words. She speaks in a natural, conversational tone:
<d>[English] Okay so... <inhale> I just saw this AI-generated video and I literally cannot tell if it's real anymore.</d>

Her hair moves naturally as she shifts her weight. The camera shakes slightly with her hand movements.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, she continues talking, gesturing with her free hand (her right hand) for emphasis. The camera angle shifts slightly as she adjusts her grip. She's animated but natural:
<d>[English] Like, the skin texture, the way the hair moves... <pause> it's actually insane.</d>

She briefly looks down at her phone screen as if checking something, then looks back up at the camera. Her expression is genuine amazement mixed with slight concern.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, she leans slightly closer to the camera, lowering her voice as if sharing something important:
<d>[English] I mean... <pause> what does "real" even mean anymore?</d>

She holds eye contact with the lens for a beat, her expression thoughtful. The video ends with her still looking at the camera, the handheld movement continuing naturally until 00:15.000.

The overall aesthetic should feel like a genuine social media vlog: natural lighting, slight camera shake, authentic speech rhythm with natural pauses, and a casual intimate framing. The image quality should feel like a modern smartphone camera - clear but not cinematic, with natural depth of field.

overall_soundscape:
Natural room tone with very subtle ambient background noise. The sound of her voice is clear but has the slight compression and frequency response of a phone microphone. Occasional subtle clothing rustle as she moves. No artificial audio processing.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A. This is meant to feel like a raw, unedited vlog recording with no added music.

nodes.title: HOW TO USE · Qwen stills → MiniMax H3 video
widgets_values:
STEP 1 · STILLS (Qwen)
- Toggle above: enable '1 · QWEN'.
- Fill the 4 image slots, write the prompt, pick size (1376x768 for 16:9), Queue.
- One still per Queue -> output/QwenShots/multishot_xxxxx.png. Repeat per scene.

STEP 2 · VIDEO (MiniMax H3)
- Toggle: enable '2 · MINIMAX H3 — video' (this turns Qwen off).
- In the MiniMax area (below), load your stills into the Image Reference loaders.
  A loader with its Set node bypassed is an unused slot: select both and press Ctrl+B to use it.
- Edit 'Generation Prompt' (subject_definitions / summary / detailed_description), set length, Queue.

The Director timeline of LTX does not exist in MiniMax: MiniMax takes ONE prompt + reference images/videos/audio per clip.
